description_en: A framework for building realtime voice AI agents 🤖🎙️📹
readme_excerpt: Looking for the JS/TS library? Check out AgentsJS What is Agents? The Agent Framework is designed for building realtime, programmable participants that run on servers. Use it to create conversational, multi-modal voice agents that can see, hear, and understand.
